audited_source_corrections.action: Handled the empty set separately before evaluating the choice function at A in the recursion base.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The construction begins with g(0)=f(A), but if A is empty then f is defined only on nonempty subsets of A and f(A) is undefined. The empty set is already well-ordered.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: காலிக் கணம் நேரடியாக நன்கு வரிசைப்படும் என்று கூறி, மீள்வரையறையில் காலியற்ற கணத்தை மட்டும் கருதுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Silently assuming A nonempty in the theorem for all sets.

audited_source_corrections.action: Assigned the stop sentinel only at and after the first exhausted stage instead of overwriting all preceding stages.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The source says that upon first exhaustion at alpha, g(delta)=A for every delta at most alpha. That overwrites the earlier selected values and destroys the displayed injectivity argument. The sentinel must apply from alpha onward.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: முதலில் நிற்கும் alpha நிலையிலிருந்து பின்னருள்ள delta குறிகளுக்கே நிரப்பு மதிப்பு A வழங்கப்படுகிறது; முன்னைய தேர்வுகள் பாதுகாக்கப்படுகின்றன.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Retaining the reversed inequality or leaving the stop marker without any rigorous expansion.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The recursion has chosen distinct elements at all stages below alpha; those values cannot be overwritten. A harmless fixed sentinel after exhaustion makes the class recursion total while the desired bijection is its pre-stop restriction.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Are all pre-stop values preserved and the sentinel confined to stages delta at least alpha?

audited_source_corrections.action: Scoped injectivity, range equality and the final bijection to the initial segment before the stop sentinel.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The source says g is injective and finally a bijection from an ordinal to A while also specifying a constant sentinel after exhaustion. The full class function is then not injective and its range also contains the sentinel A.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: ஒருமுகத்தன்மை, வீச்சு மற்றும் இறுதி இருபுறச் சார்பு ஆகியவற்றை நிறுத்துமுன் கிடைக்கும் தொடக்கத் துண்டுக்கே உரியதாகத் தெளிவுபடுத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Calling the post-stop total class function injective, or suppressing the stop extension without explaining the domain restriction.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Before the first exhausted stage alpha, recursion chooses new elements of A; the restriction g|alpha is an injective surjection onto A and transports the ordinal well-order.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the final bijection refer precisely to the restriction before the first exhausted stage?
